policy.held_out_policy: Development errors only. Held-out or test data must not be used to update a skill.

entries.note_en: Candidate-v3.2 initializes the error-book lifecycle. Its private typical-case report contains 12 full cases, error mechanisms, and an index of all 33 discrepancies.
